items.prompt: You tell a friend: ___ aquí un momento. (venir)
items.explanation: The tú imperative of venir is irregular: ven.
optionNotes: Viene is the él form, and venir has an irregular imperative: ven.

items.prompt: You tell a stranger: ___ a la derecha. (girar)
items.explanation: Usted imperative of an -ar verb: -e. Gire.
optionNotes: The infinitive is not used for this.

items.prompt: You ask a friend to call you tomorrow:
items.explanation: Pronouns are attached to the imperative, and the stress needs an accent: llámame.
optionNotes: Me before the verb makes a statement, not an instruction.
The pronoun appears only once, attached to the end.
The pronoun is written together with the verb.

items.explanation: The tú imperative of hacer is irregular: haz.
optionNotes: Hace is the él form; the imperative is haz.
The infinitive is not used for this.
